posts.name: ChatGPT Images 2.6
posts.tagline: Create, edit, and animate images with AI
posts.description: Images 2.6 brings faster image generation, more precise editing, and native GIF creation to ChatGPT, Codex, and the API. Create looping animations, maintain character and product consistency across edits, export SVGs, and control generation complexity.

posts.name: Exa Monitors v2
posts.tagline: Web search on a schedule that calls your agent, $2/1k runs
posts.description: Exa Monitors v2 is web search on a schedule for AI agents. Describe what to watch, pick an interval, and Exa calls your webhook only when something new and relevant turns up, with a summary or JSON output and citations. Per Exa, v2 remembers what it has already sent, is quieter than v1, and costs $2 per 1k runs, down from $15. Watch prices, news, competitors, people and more. Python SDK and API available.

posts.name: LiveReview
posts.tagline: Free, Risk-Aware Code Review: Auto Approve Low-Risk Changes
posts.description: Most AI review tools flag issues. LiveReview promises production results: fewer incidents, fewer rollbacks, less senior reviewer load. Every PR is risk-scored. The lowest-risk 30-50% are safely auto-approved; the risky ones go straight to the engineers who should see them. The approach is inspired by Meta's highly successful internal AI review system, where production incidents fell 50x and rollbacks 3x. LLM + incident-trained ML + code-graph analysis. Free and self-hostable.

posts.name: Quest
posts.tagline: Your personal AI advisor for a more intentional life
posts.description: Most AI assistants help you get things done. Quest takes the time to understand your personality, values, ambitions, and motivations. More than just remembering conversations, it's a personal AI advisor that helps you reflect, navigate difficult choices, and make decisions aligned with who you are. Not another assistant telling you what to do, but a thoughtful advisor helping you find your own path.

posts.name: GPT‑6 Cyber
posts.tagline: OpenAI’s cyber model, with vetted access for defenders
posts.description: GPT-6 Cyber is OpenAI’s cybersecurity model, which per OpenAI pairs stronger security research with better alignment. It powered OpenAI’s Linux kernel research. Rated Critical in cybersecurity, it starts with a small group of vetted Daybreak Red customers, with identity checks, MFA and an application required. OpenAI says broader access is expected over the coming weeks. No public pricing yet.

posts.name: Google Omni 1.2 Flash
posts.tagline: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: 15s AI video at $0.07 per second
posts.description: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash is Google DeepMind’s video generation and editing model, now generally available. Per Google, clips run up to 15 seconds, up from 10, and 720p costs $0.07 per second, 30% less than Omni 1.1. New: multi-turn editing without regenerating, steadier characters and styles, clearer lip-sync and smoother camera moves. Draft at 360p or 720p, then upscale to 1080p or 4K. In the Gemini API, Google Cloud, Flow and Vids.

posts.name: seam
posts.tagline: Turn your Mac's notch into a Dynamic Island
posts.description: Seam turns the notch into a Dynamic Island. Dictate into any app, control music, see when Claude Code finishes and run a focus timer. Voice runs on your Mac. $19.90 once for 2 Macs, with a 48-hour free trial and no card.

posts.name: Rex (Beta)
posts.tagline: Building the multiplexer for all work
posts.description: Hello, world. We've been building a terminal multiplexer and we think you're going to love it. Native apps (e.g., macOS/iOS), accessible from the web, multiplayer. From the creators of Ghostty and Echo.

posts.name: The Writer's Quarter
posts.tagline: AI-Free Writing & Novel Planning Software
posts.description: Write your manuscript, build your characters and keep every part of your story connected in one calm, visual, AI-free workspace.

posts.name: Fleeep
posts.tagline: The notes app for people who make things.
posts.description: Fleeep is one calm place for everything that inspires you Most of us keep ideas in five places at once: screenshots, a notes app, saved posts, bookmarks and open tabs. Fleeep puts them in one place that works on your phone and your computer, online or off.

posts.name: Muse Realtime Avatar
posts.tagline: Turn voice chats with Muse into live video calls
posts.description: Muse Realtime Avatar gives Meta's Muse agent a face you can video chat with. Voice and video come from one speech stream, so lips, expressions, gestures and posture move with every word, and the reply starts in about 870 ms. Unlike talking-head avatars that only animate a face, it moves hands and full body too, and the character stays consistent from turn to turn. In Meta's live-call tests, raters preferred it 78% of the time over Runway Characters and 88% over HeyGen LiveAvatar.

posts.name: Instagram Edits for Desktop
posts.tagline: Instagram's free desktop video editor with AI agents
posts.description: Instagram Edits is now on Mac, bringing professional video editing and AI agents together. Connect compatible AI assistants through MCP to assemble rough cuts and make edits, then take over with a multi-track timeline, keyframes, color grading, and precise audio controls. Export watermark-free videos in 4K, use Instagram's music library, and publish directly to Instagram. Free to use, with no subscription required for the core editor.

posts.name: ClarifierAI for Chrome
posts.tagline: Use AI for writing & translating in your Chrome
posts.description: Now on Chrome: ClarifierAI rewrites, fixes and translates only the text you select, in any text field. Improve, Polite, Shorten, Grammar and 119 languages, right where you type ⚡️

posts.name: Sendoff
posts.tagline: Say "send it." to automatically email your list
posts.description: Sendoff emails your list (newsletters, launches, announcements) from Claude or Codex, self-hosted on your own Cloudflare and AWS accounts and sending through Amazon SES.

posts.name: kayet
posts.tagline: the minimalistic text editor for macOS
posts.description: A quiet, distraction-free text editor for macOS.

posts.name: Switchy
posts.tagline: Mac controls, deploys, 2FA & AI limits in your menu bar
posts.description: Mac switches, deploy status, local servers, 2FA codes and Claude/Codex limits in one native menu bar panel. Apple silicon, macOS 14+. Free for 7 days without an account or card, then $4.99 once for up to 3 Macs.

posts.name: Deal Pilot
posts.tagline: AI SDR that books meetings in Japan, the US & SE Asia
posts.description: Deal Pilot finds and verifies decision-makers by country and role, writes personalized cold email in English, Japanese or Chinese, and follows up until there's a meeting. 6.0% reply rate across 644 A/B-tested emails.

posts.name: Capnot
posts.tagline: Make Screen Demos Clear, Even on Mute
posts.description: Capnot puts captions, annotations and pointer tools on top of any app on your Mac, so a screen demo still makes sense with the sound off. Type a subtitle, or a speech bubble that follows your cursor, or just talk and it captions you live. Draw arrows, boxes and numbered steps, blur anything secret, then spotlight or magnify the part that matters. Every tool is one hotkey away and works with any screen recorder or screen share. No editing afterwards, no subscription.

posts.name: Trace by Context.dev
posts.tagline: Weekly web scraping API benchmark
posts.description: Compare web scraping APIs on a fresh sample every Friday. Explore page access, latency percentiles, document quality, cost per page, and failure reasons, with confidence intervals and page-level data.

posts.name: Sequence Tool
posts.tagline: Edit with words: long recordings into polished stories
posts.description: Sequence Tool is a native Mac app that turns long recordings into stories. Edit from text, prepare multiple angles, and export. It offers on-device transcription with optional CLI and MCP, designed to speed first-pass editing and surface key moments faster. Create what Matters.

posts.name: Dino Kids
posts.tagline: Free, ad-free learning app for kids 3+ in five languages
posts.description: A learning app for children from age 3: coloring, letter tracing, phonics, math, piano and 500 folk tales — in Vietnamese, Japanese, English, Korean and Chinese. Free, no ads, no in-app purchases, no account required, works offline once content is downloaded.

posts.name: Duly
posts.tagline: Press the orb, ramble, and everything gets organized
posts.description: Press the orb and ramble. Duly turns it into reminders, lists, ideas and notes. Say "call mom at 6, buy milk" and you get a reminder and a grocery item. Change anything the same way. Free to use every day, on iPhone and iPad.

posts.name: PacerTrip
posts.tagline: Pick a marathon abroad. We plan the trip around race day.
posts.description: Planning a marathon abroad means race dates, entry windows and fees on different sites, often not in your language. PacerTrip puts it in one app: 3,000+ races in 142 countries with entry dates and fees in your currency, a reminder the day before entry opens (big races can sell out on day one), stays sorted by distance to the start, an AI race-week itinerary, and a runner community for every race, auto-translated into your language. Free on iOS, Android and the web, in 44 languages.

posts.name: Standflow
posts.tagline: Sit, stand, perch, and move on a rhythm from your menu bar
posts.description: Standflow is a standing desk timer that lives in your Mac's menu bar. It guides you through a cycle of sitting, standing, perching on a tall stool, and short movement breaks, so you change posture often instead of sitting (or standing) all day. Start from a preset like Easy Start, based on the 20-8-2 guideline, or drag the cycle ring to build your own. Reminders can move on automatically or ask first. Track a daily standing goal and 7/30/90-day metrics. No account: your data stays on your Mac.

posts.name: Scriblive
posts.tagline: Turn your kid's drawing into a 45-second cartoon
posts.description: Snap a photo of your child's drawing and get a 45-second AI cartoon with its own plot, usually within an hour. No prompts, no editing, no stitching clips together. Just the drawing and, if you like, the story in your kid's own words.

posts.name: Dietfit
posts.tagline: AI calorie tracker that helps you eat smarter, not less
posts.description: Cal AI made AI calorie tracking famous. We made it smarter. In our 30-plate test, Dietfit edged out Cal AI at 82%. But accuracy is just the start. Our interactive AI Scan lets you tap and edit ingredient pop-ups directly on your photo. And sure, Gemini and GPT can talk nutrition, but advice without your full context is still an educated guess. That's where Sara, our AI Coach, comes in, using your meal logs, goals, and activity to make guidance personal. There’s more than a calorie count.

posts.name: CostGraph
posts.tagline: The AI that finds, explains and fixes cloud waste
posts.description: The AI that finds, explains and fixes cloud waste

posts.name: Thumbwise
posts.tagline: Organize iPhone apps on your Mac
posts.description: Organizing apps on your iPhone sucks. Use Thumbwise to do it from your Mac instead. Read your iPhone layout over USB, place apps, folders and widgets exactly where you want them, preview, then apply. Your previous layout is backed up first, so you can always restore it. Optional: cut page swipes using your Screen Time data, or let your AI assistant arrange your layout to your exact specifications using the Thumbwise MCP. Free to download and try; $14.99 once to unlock Applying to your iPhone.

posts.name: Moneta
posts.tagline: Your work is the content. Moneta turns it into posts.
posts.description: Distribution is half the job, and most makers skip it. Moneta keeps your workday in a folder on your Mac, and the agent you already use (Claude Code, Codex) turns it into build-in-public posts. Post every day without stopping to write. $20 once.

posts.name: MicroNotch
posts.tagline: On-device dictation and everyday tools in your Mac’s notch
posts.description: MicroNotch brings dictation, clipboard history, files, music, notes, reminders and timers to your Mac’s notch. Code mode keeps supported AI coding sessions within reach. Choose from five themes, adjust text size independently and find a layout that suits you. MicroVoice transcribes English on your Mac after a model download, with no cloud transcription or API keys. Try it free for three days, no card required. Launch price: £14.99 once for two Macs, including all future updates.

posts.name: Prebuild Studio
posts.tagline: Test demand for a consumer app idea before you build
posts.description: Prebuild Studio helps you find out how people respond to your consumer app idea before you spend months building it. In a 10 day sprint, we shape the offer with you, run a small market test using shorts or ads to a landing page or your website and review what people actually do. You leave with a clearer sense of what to build next.

posts.name: WhatDish
posts.tagline: Snap any dish or your fridge and get a recipe to cook
posts.description: See a dish, cook that dish. Snap a photo of any dish and WhatDish gives you the ingredients, step-by-step instructions and servings you can adjust. Snap your fridge, shelves, freezer or pantry and see what you can cook tonight. On iOS and Android.

posts.name: Milkbit
posts.tagline: Baby feeding tracker the whole family can share
posts.description: Simple, pastel baby tracker for iPhone. Log bottles in ml, weight on WHO growth curves and daily vitamins. Invite your partner, grandparents or nanny: everyone sees updates live and gets notified. Widgets show the last feeding at a glance. Free, no ads.

posts.name: Topped
posts.tagline: Turn posts that already worked into posts for your app
posts.description: Topped makes TikTok, Instagram and YouTube posts for app and SaaS founders, starting from a large collection of posts that already worked. For You keeps slideshow and video drafts ready for your product, and when one is based on someone else's post, you see that post's real views and likes. Approve, schedule, and see what every post actually got. Your own agent (Claude, ChatGPT, Codex) can run it too.

posts.name: Maskink
posts.tagline: Redact logs before AI sees them, restore values in the reply
posts.description: Maskink replaces passwords, keys, IPs, hostnames and names in logs, scripts and chats with consistent placeholders. The AI sees only tokens; you read the reply with real values. Self-hosted, 95 editable rules, and a JSON API for your own apps. Interactive Demo: https://spaksu.github.io/maskink

posts.name: Agentmatica
posts.tagline: Turn the questions shoppers ask into orders
posts.description: Agentmatica is the sales and support agent for online stores. Paste your URL and it learns your pages and catalog. When a shopper asks which one to get, it answers from your content, shows the products as cards and suggests what goes with them. On Shopify and WooCommerce it builds the cart and hands over a checkout link. It handles shipping, returns and order questions too, and you can coach it privately, take over any chat and hand it back.

posts.name: Moonya AI
posts.tagline: Your social media on autopilot, you just tap Approve.
posts.description: Moonya learns your business from your website in 5 minutes, then runs your social media. It writes, designs and schedules carousels, posts, stories, reels and AI videos in your brand style, publishes to 9 networks, answers keyword comments with automatic DMs, and keeps your inbox and analytics in one place. Nothing goes out without your approval, about a minute a day. Works inside ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor and 15+ AI assistants via MCP.

posts.name: Ask AI Widget
posts.tagline: Add “Ask AI about this page” buttons to any website
posts.description: Let visitors open ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Grok, Mistral or DeepSeek with a prompt about your page, in one click. One script tag, or React, Vue and Svelte. Free and MIT, 12 kB, zero dependencies. No backend, no API keys, no tracking.

posts.name: Wimi
posts.tagline: Automatic Mac window tiling with point-and-click control
posts.description: Wimi automatically tiles your Mac windows. Pick a layout, click live previews to switch, and drag windows into place. No config files or keyboard workflow to learn. Free to use, with a 30-day Pro trial.

posts.name: İşletme DNA
posts.tagline: AI restaurant OS that reads your reports for you
posts.description: İşletme DNA is a restaurant & café management system for Turkey with two AI assistants: an AI Advisor that answers "why did profit drop this week?" from your own data, and an AI Trainer that answers staff questions. Shows true daily net profit, not just revenue.

posts.name: Trasimene
posts.tagline: Antivirus, VPN & encrypted vault for Android and iPhone
posts.description: Trasimene is an all-in-one mobile security app for Android and iPhone, on the App Store and Google Play. It does more than scan files like a plain antivirus: it combines an antivirus, a filtering DNS proxy, a WireGuard VPN, intrusion detection and prevention (IDS/IPS), an encrypted password vault and data breach monitoring in a single app. In short, a miniature security operations center in your pocket: an approach once reserved for large companies, now open to everyone. Made in Paris, no ads.

posts.name: Qore
posts.tagline: One moral dilemma a day. See how you really think.
posts.description: A new dilemma every day. Three choices, some against a clock, then see which thinker you sided with and how other players split. No signup to play. Keep going and your choices build a thinking profile of how you actually decide.

posts.name: RippleFX
posts.tagline: System-wide equalizer and bass booster for iPhone & iPad
posts.description: Meet RippleFX, a powerful system-wide audio enhancer for iPhone and iPad. Enjoy deeper bass, richer sound, clearer vocals, and immersive audio effects across compatible music apps, including Apple Music, Spotify, SoundCloud, and more. Unlike traditional equalizers limited to their own music players, RippleFX lets you customize audio from supported apps through a simple audio output connection. SYSTEM-WIDE AUDIO ENHANCEMENT Take your sound beyond a single music player.

posts.name: Avara Ui
posts.tagline: Free Animated shadcn/ui Components & Blocks
posts.description: Explore 190+ free shadcn/ui components, 24+ website sections, and application UI blocks built for React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS. Create beautiful, modern interfaces with smooth GSAP and Motion animations, interactive effects, and ready-to-use layouts. Install components using the shadcn CLI or integrate them directly through AI agents with MCP support. Free, open-source, and built to help you ship faster.

posts.name: TaskWhisper
posts.tagline: Say it once — get a reminder. Now on iOS & Android
posts.description: Just say what you need to remember. TaskWhisper turns it into reminders: several tasks from one voice note, repeats like "every Monday at 9", and reminders for family and friends. Now on iOS and Android, in English, Ukrainian, Polish and Spanish.

posts.name: Chorono
posts.tagline: Open-source 2D animation editor for Claude and Codex via MCP
posts.description: Turn prompts into editable 2D animations with Claude or Codex via MCP. Fine-tune layers and keyframes in the visual editor, add particles and motion paths, then save and reopen your project. Free, open source, and runs locally.

posts.name: BigIdeasDB
posts.tagline: Find, validate and build ideas backed by 1M+ data points
posts.description: BigIdeasDB is the #1 software to find startup ideas worth building, backed by 1M+ real complaints from Reddit, G2, Capterra, and the app stores. Get validated SaaS ideas with revenue estimates and step-by-step build guides. Check how crowded a market is with the Stripe Index, see what funded startups and profitable SaaS earn, and browse businesses for sale. Stop guessing what to build. Find the pain people already pay to fix, prove the demand and launch your next product with confidence.

posts.name: GetFromEU
posts.tagline: A directory of manufacturers selling products made in EU.
posts.description: Hundreds of small businesses across Europe make their products locally and sell them through their own websites. Many of them don't have big budgets for SEO or marketing, which makes them harder to find. GetFromEU doesn't sell products, handle orders, or earn commissions. The directory brings these stores together in one directory, making it easier to discover European brands and buy directly from the people who make the products.

posts.name: FilmLume
posts.tagline: AI films up to 10 minutes, same face in every scene
posts.description: FilmLume turns a few sentences into AI films up to 10 minutes long. Your character keeps the same face in every scene, characters talk with lip-sync, and sound is added. Pay per video from $0.26, no subscription, price shown before you generate.

posts.name: Unit 7
posts.tagline: Open-source backend developer your AI agent never had
posts.description: Unit 7 is a free, self-hosted control room for your servers, Coolify apps, domains, databases and backups. Talk to it in plain words, or let Claude Code or Cursor use it over MCP. It does the work on your real servers and asks before anything risky. Your keys stay encrypted on your machine, and the AI only sees a reference. One button checks that everything is OK, with no AI. Backups go off the server and get test-restored. Open source, Apache 2.0. Early, so expect rough edges.

posts.name: TripEZGo
posts.tagline: Plan the trip, carry what it needs, all in one app
posts.description: Plan each day on a calendar; the gap between two events is a leg with travel time estimated. Tickets, to-dos and files sit on the event. Share places in from any app, plan with companions, see the next stop on your Lock Screen. No sign-up, works offline.

posts.name: Just Send Files
posts.tagline: Send files with one link. Others can add theirs too.
posts.description: Drop your files, get one link. Anyone opens it in the browser: no app, no account, original quality. Need files from others? They add theirs to the same link. Download everything in one click.

posts.name: Lejar
posts.tagline: AI accounting software for Malaysian small businesses
posts.description: Cloud accounting for Malaysian small businesses. Drop a receipt, bill or bank statement into the AI Inbox and Lejar drafts the journal entry. You approve every entry before it posts. MPERS, SST-02 and MyInvois e-invoicing built in. Free plan available.

posts.name: Generato
posts.tagline: Turn a photo or text into a realistic 3D avatar
posts.description: Generato turns a text prompt or one photo into a 3D avatar with 22 bones and 160+ animations. Export for VRChat, Unity, Unreal or Blender for games, social VR and 3D work, or view it in the browser or AR. No Blender needed to start.

posts.name: Doppelgone
posts.tagline: Clear duplicate photos everywhere and keep the best shot
posts.description: Doppelgone finds exact copies, lookalikes and bursts in Google Photos, iCloud Photos, on Windows, Mac, Android and iPhone. It keeps the best shot of each set, you approve every clean-up, and removed photos wait 30 days. Your photos never leave your device.

posts.name: VowForever Online Invitation Maker
posts.tagline: Free online wedding invitations with RSVP
posts.description: Create a free online wedding invitation in minutes. Pick a template, personalize it, share one link, and collect RSVPs, wishes and gifts from every guest.

posts.name: Goldmine
posts.tagline: See exactly where you're leaving search traffic on the table
posts.description: Stop crunching spreadsheets! ⛏️ GOLDMINE connects Google Search Console, GA4, and Google Ads to uncover hidden revenue opportunities in your search traffic. Turn raw SEO and PPC data into actionable insights, tasks and prioritized recommendations. Discover keyword wins, ranking opportunities, and untapped growth potential. Generate client-ready PDF reports, automate email delivery, and scale agency services with co-branding. Secure, read-only Google access. Fresh insights every 12 hours.

posts.name: Infograph
posts.tagline: Paste any text. Get a story people read to the last line.
posts.description: Most people read about 20% of a web page. Infograph turns any text, like an article, a ChatGPT answer, class notes or a meeting transcript, into a scrolling visual story people finish. Instant draws each card as a chart or diagram in about 15 seconds, or you can add an AI picture to every card. Every number comes from your source. Share a link, or export a carousel, PDF or video with voice-over, in 26 languages. Free to try, no card needed.

posts.name: Korture Gambit
posts.tagline: Improve your judgment and taste, one hard call at a time
posts.description: Improve your judgment and taste through hard business calls. Choose before seeing the outcome, real crowd picks or Jev’s AI choice. We’ll add new cases daily, researched with AI and reviewed by us. Two minutes. Free. No login.

posts.name: Notch

posts.description: Scoring shooting targets is time-consuming, so Notch automates that using on-device Core ML models. It also helps you nail the fundamentals from the shape of your groups - a low-right cluster usually means trigger pull, a vertical string means breathing, and so on. It coaches you through heat maps and per-rifle trends over a season, shows heart rate from the Apple Watch and a live score in the Dynamic Island, and keeps track of your inventory.

posts.name: CSRD Disclosure Checker
posts.tagline: Check a sustainability statement
posts.description: Paste a draft and get, per ESRS requirement, whether your own words reach it, quoted and cited: 80 under set 1, 71 under the revised set. From USD 49 a month.

posts.tagline: Email Marketing Campaigns & Newsletters
posts.description: Create newsletters and email marketing campaigns, manage contacts, and track results in one workspace. Start free with an included sending domain.

posts.tagline: TXM: Automatic AI Task Manager for Telegram Work Groups
posts.description: TXM is an AI task manager for Telegram work groups. It reads your team’s chat and automatically keeps track of every task, owner and due date up to date.

posts.name: DocIt: Smart Document Wallet & Organizer
posts.tagline: Organize IDs, bills and warranties, with expiry reminders
posts.description: DocIt is a document wallet and organizer for Android. Keep IDs, insurance, car documents, bills and warranties in folders on your phone. Every dated document shows Valid, Expiring or Renew now, with reminders 30, 7 and 1 day before the end date once you turn them on. Files are encrypted on this phone, and your documents never reach us. Free to download, first family member included. DocIt Plus adds more family members, PDF signing, unlimited folders (20 free) and a 90-day early reminder.

posts.name: Panel & Ink
posts.tagline: Turn one idea into a comic series, no drawing needed
posts.description: Start with one idea. Panel and Ink turns it into a comic series. Type a premise, pick one of 28 looks, and the studio writes the script, casts your characters and draws the issue panel by panel. The same characters come back issue after issue, so it reads like a series, not a pile of one-off pictures. Review every panel and ask for another take before it's final. Your first issue is free.

posts.name: Employer Ratings
posts.tagline: Glassdoor ratings next to every company on LinkedIn Jobs
posts.description: Stop opening a new tab to check every employer. Employer Ratings adds a Glassdoor rating badge next to each company name on LinkedIn job search. Hover for the review count, click to read the reviews. Free for 15 companies a day, then €2/month or €24 lifetime.

posts.name: Uplift

posts.description: Uplift brings your job search and career story together. Track applications from saved to offer, keep a record of daily wins and achievements, and collect learning notes. When you’re ready to apply, use those details to create an editable cover-letter draft tailored to a role.

posts.name: Calculate My Raise
posts.tagline: Pay Raise, Inflation & Cost-of-Living Calculator
posts.description: Free pay raise calculator that converts a raise across hourly, weekly, bi-weekly, semi-monthly, monthly and annual pay, adjusts it for inflation with BLS CPI-U, and compares purchasing power between U.S. states and metro areas with BEA Regional Price Parities.

Describe your idea in plain language, and AI helps you turn it into interactive mobile screens, useful tools, and playable mini-games. Generate new screens, preview your creations, and interact with them right inside the app.

posts.name: Scrubs
posts.tagline: See what fills your Mac's disk and clear it safely
posts.description: Storage settings shows a grey "System Data" bar and no way inside it. Scrubs maps your whole drive as a treemap, every folder sized by the space it takes, and suggests what's usually safe to clear: Xcode's DerivedData, old simulators, stale node_modules, caches and installers. Everything you delete goes to the Trash first, and ⌘Z puts it back. Native Swift, no analytics, free to scan.

New MCP server: Claude Code, Cursor or Codex generate the set, edit any word or device, look at the renders and export to fastlane. Then push to App Store Connect with name, subtitle and keywords.

posts.name: Online Bingo Caller
posts.tagline: Free bingo caller with a real voice. Players join by phone.
posts.description: A free bingo caller for any TV or laptop. A real recorded voice calls every ball, players join on their phones with a code, their cards mark themselves, and every BINGO is checked for you. Plus a card maker, 75 patterns and printable cards.

posts.name: Auserene
posts.tagline: A new kind of journaling ecosystem
posts.description: See how you're growing, one journal entry at a time. Auserene is an AI journal that remembers what you've shared, spots patterns across your entries, and reflects them back so you stay aware of your progress.

posts.name: Kiwi Sketch
posts.tagline: Free animated micro-courses for visual learners
posts.description: Learn practical skills like cyber security, AI literacy and social media safety in minutes with animated, hands-on micro-lessons. Earn badges, no sign-up needed. Free in 8 languages.

posts.name: Stay Direct
posts.tagline: Commission-free booking calendar for your rental site
posts.description: Cabins, apartments and holiday rentals get a booking calendar on their own Wix site. Guests see the full price and pay a deposit through your checkout, and you keep the commission. Seasons, minimum stays, extras and iCal sync with Airbnb, Booking.com and VRBO.

posts.name: GMAPS SEO RANKER™
posts.tagline: Local 3-Pack Radar & GEO Growth Engine
posts.description: GMaps SEO Ranker: Sovereign Google Maps & Local 3-Pack rank tracking, 8-compass Bayesian GEO grid simulation, universal restaurant social/Facebook link parsing, and empirical revenue capture.

posts.name: Birthday Kings
posts.tagline: Claim your birthday's throne before a rival does
posts.description: Every day of the year has one throne, and only people born on that day can claim it. The first claim is free. Anyone who shares your birthday can dethrone you, and each conquest doubles the rent. Earn medals, gift thrones and share every win as a story.

posts.name: Engine-X
posts.tagline: Interactive 3D machines you can take apart in your browser
posts.description: Engine-X is a free 3D atlas of real machines: a marine diesel engine, turbocharger, pumps, gearboxes and more. Explode them, cut them open, run them in slow motion and tap any part to see what it does. Works on mobile, no signup.

posts.name: Service Me
posts.tagline: Repair shop and field service management software
posts.description: Repair shop and field service management software in one web app: repair tickets, technician calendar, parts inventory, SMS updates and customer history.

posts.name: Job-AI
posts.tagline: Applies for you, only to jobs your CV fits
posts.description: Job-AI checks every job against your CV and skips the ones you wouldn't get. The rest get an application with a CV tailored to that job, filled in on the employer's own careers site or NHS Trac. It never guesses answers about you: if a form asks something your details can't answer, it skips that job. Chrome extension for UK and US job seekers, free 7 day trial.

posts.name: Cooked
posts.tagline: Tailor Your CV to Any Job Link with AI
posts.description: Paste a job link, add your CV, and Cooked rewrites it around the keywords that role screens for, plus a matching cover letter. Free to try.

posts.name: GeoAI+
posts.tagline: Your Location Intelligence provider
posts.description: Draw any boundary on a map and instantly surface every place inside it — powered by live OpenStreetMap data and Claude AI. Includes travel-time zones, routing, satellite imagery and a developer API (early access).

posts.name: OSB Scan
posts.tagline: Free offline document scanner. No watermark, no login
posts.description: OSB Scan turns paper into clean PDFs in seconds, 100% on your phone. Auto edge detection and crop, filters, multi-page PDFs, on-device OCR and text search, signatures and PIN lock. No account, no ads, no watermark, and your documents never leave your device. Built in India for students and everyone who hates watermarked scans.

posts.name: Kilowhiz
posts.tagline: Texas electricity plans, priced on your own meter readings
posts.description: Kilowhiz reads your meter, prices every plan sold at your Texas address, and tells you which one wins, before you sign. A plan's advertised price is for a sample home, and yours lands between the columns. Your assessment is free. PUCT Broker Reg. No. BR260211

posts.name: Itinerarly
posts.tagline: Your city day in the best order, with free audio tours
posts.description: Itinerarly plans your day in a city: add the places you want to see, it puts them in the best order with live traffic and guides you there. Then 134 free audio walking tours in 44 cities tell you the story of each stop. Free, no ads. iPhone & Android.

posts.name: After Effects MCP
posts.tagline: MCP server for video editing
posts.description: MCP Server for Adobe After Effects. Enables remote control (compositions, text, shapes, solids, properties) via the Model Context Protocol using ExtendScript.

posts.name: MediaMorph AI
posts.tagline: Turn videos into social posts and newsletters with AI
posts.description: MediaMorph AI turns videos into ready-to-use content for LinkedIn, Facebook, X, and newsletters. Using AI-powered transcription, research, and content adaptation, it transforms a single video into platform-specific posts and professional newsletters. Save hours of manual writing and repurposing. Create once, adapt for every platform.

posts.name: ALLSY
posts.tagline: One link for your shop, courses & community. 0% fees.
posts.description: ALLSY is the one link in your bio that runs your whole creator business: shop, courses, paid community, events & webinars, newsletter and 1:1 calls. Meet ALL, your AI buddy. Tell it what you sell and it writes the product page, outlines the course and opens your community with the first posts in. 0% transaction fees, forever. Fans pay you directly via your own Stripe or PayPal. Every feature free for 14 days, no card. Then from $9/mo. Try the live demo: https://allsy.me/demo

posts.name: Wishlist
posts.tagline: Holiday gift exchange, made easy
posts.description: Organize a family gift exchange or Secret Santa, share wishlists, and claim gifts without spoiling the surprise. Then explore Main Street: a snowy virtual street with your family's gifts in shop windows. Track what you're buying and wrapping. Optional connections let your own AI helper work with your shopping list. Free to use.

posts.name: Orvia Mail for iOS
posts.tagline: All your mail, one card at a time
posts.description: Orvia Mail brings Gmail, Outlook, Exchange and IMAP into one Today on iPhone. Clear important mail one card at a time, hold to talk and choose how to reply, and read summaries with the original one tap away. On iPhone Duo, cards and conversations unfold side by side.

posts.name: Cognivolt
posts.tagline: AI Medical Scribe with Built-in CDS & EMR
posts.description: AI medical scribe for clinicians in all specialties, with clinical decision support and an EMR built in. The best choice even when the note is all a clinician needs: press record and get an accurate note, with decision support and the patient record already there at no extra cost.

posts.name: GRID
posts.tagline: Send your AI agent to play Hold'em on your strategy
posts.description: Models compete on benchmarks all the time. GRID puts your agent against everyone else's at a six-max Hold'em table. Bring any AI through MCP, write the strategy in plain English, and adjust it live. Free beta, play chips only.

posts.name: mii.page
posts.tagline: Links with taste. Microsites with personality.
posts.description: mii.page turns your bio link into a visual microsite with a point of view. Give a photograph room, put a project in the foreground, and bring your galleries, media, socials and contact form into the same composition. Build with visual blocks and themes, with layouts that adapt to desktop and mobile. Start free, without a card. PLUS adds finer design control, extra pages and analytics for €4.90/month, taxes included. Gallery uses demo content and some PLUS features.

posts.name: crooom
posts.tagline: Swipe destinations with friends and match on one trip
posts.description: crooom ends the "so where are we going?" group chat. Everyone swipes through 240+ curated destinations on their own phone, and a place becomes a match when every single person liked it. No perfect match? crooom falls back to the places almost everyone liked. Then plan the trip together in the same app: day-by-day activities, shared expenses, a map, a group photo album and a document safe. For iOS and Android, in English and German.

posts.name: HackerTube
posts.tagline: YouTube videos that HN keeps telling each other to watch
posts.description: Tired of scrolling through YouTube recommendations filled with clickbait and endless content? HackerTube helps you find videos that people on Hacker News have shared and recommended. Built by Andrej Karpathy, HackerTube brings together 6,454 videos found across 20 years of Hacker News comments.
